description: This Java source file defines an immutable implementation class 'ModifyFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandImpl' that extends a generic base class and implements 'ModifyFeaturePropertiesLiveCommand'. It encapsulates logic for handling modify feature properties commands in a live signals context within the Eclipse Ditto project.
